title: CS60026: Parallel And Distributed Algorithms
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fundamentals: Models of parallel and distributed computation, complexity
measures; The PRAM Model: balancing, divide and conquer, parallel prefix
computation, pointer jumping, symmetry breaking, list ranking, sorting and
searching, graph algorithms, parallel complexity and complexity classes, lower
bounds; Interconnection Networks: topologies (arrays and mesh networks, trees,
systolic networks, hypercubes, butterfly) and fundamental algorithms, matrix
algorithms, sorting, graph algorithms, routing, relationship with PRAM models;
Asynchronous Parallel Computation; Distributed Algorithms: models and
complexity measures, safety, liveness, termination, logical time and event
ordering, global state and snapshot algorithms, mutual exclusion, clock
synchronization, election, termination detection, routing, Distributed graph
algorithms; Applications of Distributed algorithms.
